sections.label: Disk space
sections.description: Shared by every world on this computer that uses the same backup folder. /worldbackup budget shows whether the other settings fit.

sections.label: How many to keep
sections.description: Counts are per world. Older snapshots thin out: every recent one, then one a day, then one a week.

sections.label: Milestones
sections.description: Snapshots taken at moments worth going back to: game updates and mod changes. Ones you name with /worldbackup milestone are pinned and never deleted automatically.

MaxTotalMB.label: Most space for all backups (MB)
MaxTotalMB.description: Every world using this backup folder, together. When it's full, the oldest snapshots that aren't pinned or milestones go first.

MinFreeMB.label: Keep this much free on the drive (MB)
MinFreeMB.description: Below this, scheduled snapshots are skipped. Update and mod-change snapshots are still attempted.

WarnAtPercent.label: Warn when this full (%)
WarnAtPercent.description: Operators are told when the backups pass this share of the space above.

ScheduledSnapshots.label: Scheduled snapshots
ScheduledSnapshots.description: Off: only milestones and snapshots you take yourself.

SkipUnchanged.label: Skip if nothing changed
SkipUnchanged.description: Don't take a scheduled snapshot of a world nobody touched, so a quiet night doesn't push out yesterday's snapshots.

OnlyWhilePlayersOnline.label: Only while players are on
OnlyWhilePlayersOnline.description: Scheduled snapshots only while someone is playing, plus one when the last player leaves.

MaxCopyMBps.label: Speed limit while playing (MB/s)
MaxCopyMBps.description: Keeps a big snapshot from causing lag. 0: no limit. Snapshots before the world loads ignore it.

KeepScheduled.label: Recent snapshots to keep
KeepScheduled.description: Per world, every one. With one an hour, 24 is a day of play.

KeepDaily.label: Then one a day, for this many days

KeepWeekly.label: Then one a week, for this many weeks

KeepShutdown.label: Shutdown snapshots to keep
KeepShutdown.description: Per world. Taken at every clean shutdown: the last copy known to be good.

PreUpdateSnapshot.label: Snapshot before a game update
PreUpdateSnapshot.description: Taken before a new game version first opens the world, since it may upgrade the world so older versions can't open it.

ModChangeSnapshot.label: Snapshot when mods change
ModChangeSnapshot.description: Taken before the world first opens with a mod added, removed or updated.

KeepMilestones.label: Update and mod-change snapshots to keep
KeepMilestones.description: Per world, newest first. 0 keeps them all, which can fill the space above over time. Pinned snapshots never count and are never deleted.

ExcludeWorlds.label: Worlds not to back up
ExcludeWorlds.description: Servers: world names, separated by commas.

BackupDir.label: Backup folder
BackupDir.description: Empty: one shared folder for this computer. Another drive is safer.

IncludePlayers.label: Include player data
IncludePlayers.description: Servers: inventories and positions in universe/players.

AnnounceToOps.label: Tell operators
AnnounceToOps.description: A chat line when a snapshot fails, or when the space settings don't fit.
